meta.title: Vendor PO Acknowledgment: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Vendor role and attempt to accept or flag a purchase order with a committed delivery date through Vendor PO Acknowledgment.
Repeat the same PO acknowledgment action as a Vendor and compare availability or refusal.
Verify or establish that the tenant is on the Growth plan.
